query:
SELECT id, type_code, name, category, form_id, status, created_at, updated_at
        FROM document_types
        WHERE tenant_id = $1
          AND deleted_at IS NULL
          AND ($2::text IS NULL OR type_code ILIKE $2 OR name ILIKE $2)
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR status = $3)
          AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM document_type_workflows w
                WHERE w.tenant_id = $1
                  AND w.document_type_id = document_types.id
                  AND w.workflow_definition_id = $4
                  AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'
              ))
        ORDER BY type_code
        LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6
